explanation: Fast close encounter between heavy fast body and light body (distance shrinking 1.16 at step 190 to 0.65 at step 201) with substeps capped at 4 per outer step. Fixed-substep leapfrog under-resolves the strong rapidly-varying softened gravity, producing non-equal-opposite pairwise kicks that accumulate as systematic total-momentum drift until exceeding the 0.1% tolerance at step 201. Reducing dt removes the failure.
vision_note: Two blue bodies stay in very close proximity from step 198 to 201, with the smaller body just northwest of the larger body. They show almost no separation while a dotted trail extends to the northeast, consistent with a tight fast-moving encounter.
